HT-BETA-CURRICULUM-CONTEXT.notes: Human reviewer reported that the curriculum presentation appears good overall, but the curriculum tables do not scroll horizontally when the phone is held vertically. The table columns therefore cannot all be inspected in the required portrait mobile view. No broader curriculum-context PASS is inferred from this observation.

findings.title: Le tabelle del Curricolo non scorrono orizzontalmente in portrait mobile
findings.evidence: Human reviewer reported on the published 37d89ff2 release that tables do not scroll when the phone is held vertically, preventing inspection of all columns.
